Whether the Remotion Studio tab should beep when the render is finished.

## CLI flag

Use `--beep-on-finish` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                               | Flag               |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio) | `--beep-on-finish` |

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setBeepOnFinish(true);
```
